supporting_observations.claim: The periodic HTTPS activity is attributable to the approved PixelForge updater: pfupdater.exe ran from its inventoried path, and Sysmon records it connecting through the proxy during updater-domain requests.

Successful proxy connections to updates.pixelforge-suite.com occurred at 13:37:50, 13:47:45, 13:53:13, 13:58:15, 14:02:29, and 14:07:46 UTC, consistent with the inventoried updater checking about every five minutes.
The 13:42:31 request to the same updater domain was rejected with proxy status 407; this is an authentication-required response, not evidence of a successful external connection.
The updater process exited at 14:08:08, shortly after its final observed updater-domain request.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT tunnels and byte counts, but do not expose the encrypted request or response contents; for example, the updater requests are recorded as tunnels in T046-00101 and T046-00219.
The records establish process-to-proxy connections at matching times, but do not provide the updater's downloaded content or verify its integrity.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish what content, if any, the updater downloaded or whether an update was installed.
The evidence does not establish that the updater's executable or the remote service was compromised.
unrelated_findings: Separate review recommended: sam.okafor credentials were validated for a network logon to WS-SOKAFOR-01 originating from WS-LMARTINS-01, although remote administration is inventoried as being done only from WS-SOKAFOR-01. This is outside the alerted HTTPS activity. (T046-00023, T046-00024)

Separate review recommended: FILE-NWD-01 initiated an RPC connection to WS-LMARTINS-01 on port 135. This does not match the described patching practice of administration from WS-SOKAFOR-01; the available records do not establish the purpose of this connection. (T046-00063, T046-00067, T046-00068, T046-00069)

Separate software review recommended: DropboxUpdate.exe ran as SYSTEM on WS-LMARTINS-01. Dropbox is not listed among approved services, but these records do not establish that Dropbox file-sharing or synchronization occurred. (T046-00119, T046-00120, T046-00127, T046-00128)
